prompt: We have product catalogs for different locales and memory seems higher than expected. Can you check what's going on?

assertions.text: Actually connects to the cluster and lists collections
Identifies the 10+ products-{locale} collections as an antipattern
Calculates or mentions the per-collection overhead (12-14 MB each)
Recommends consolidating into a single collection with a tenant field
Checks collection config (on_disk, quantization) not just collection count
